notes: Active Optical Cable (SFPwire); optical parameters (wavelength, TX/RX power, OSNR) not specified. Bit rate stated as 10.3125 Gb/s (PRODUCT FEATURES) and BR Typ 10.3 Gb/s (IV. General Specifications). BER 10^-15 tested with 2^31-1 PRBS. Supply current Icc max 250 mA at Vcc 3.14–3.46 V; power in watts not given. Cable reach is length in meters per PRODUCT SELECTION (0.5 m–30 m); features also state lengths up to 20 m. SFI limiting; no host electrical TX pre-emphasis or RX linear equalization required. Class 1 laser product.
